recommended_actions.description: Replace exact-match prompt patching with unconditional overwrite or shot-aware mapping.
Load the target shot's submitted workflow, not the first available submitted workflow.
Either remove unused LoraLoader node or populate lora_stack with intended LoRAs.
Add IPAdapter or ControlNet nodes if the recipe requires pose/style control.

recommended_policies: Always overwrite CLIPTextEncode nodes when applying corrective retry payload, never compare existing text.
Workflow source must match the current shot_id from the generation payload.
No generation without explicit operator authorization.
No blind retry without root cause analysis.
All prompt changes must be traceable in artifact diff.
Workflow source must be verified before submission.
